name: Blaine Fitzgerald
source:
Blaine isn't all too dissimilar to the [url=/c148291]MC[/url]. A one-track mind for football. Despite coming from old money, he's never accepted the proposed offers from top schools that came based only on his last name before he'd even played a snap in high school. That 1st round projection was the fruition of the work he'd put in the last two seasons. Quiet, confrontational, but the face of Texas A&N.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/move-chains-plot-70773805]Patreon[/url]]

Coming from a wealthy family himself, he’s always fought the narrative of being bought into his potion. Despite little in the way of championships, Blaine is widely expected to be the number one overall pick in the draft following his final season at Texas A&N.

[In game description]
